examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

examples.text: Что за балаган вы тут устроили?
examples.trans: What kind of circus have you set up here?
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?
I can see the toy car.

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

выставить.gloss: to put out; to post (guards); to kick out

meanings.en: to put out, to display, to exhibit
to kick out, to throw out

examples.text: Да никто не придет, я охрану выставлю.
examples.trans: Nobody will come, I'll post guards.
He was thrown out of the restaurant.

examples.text: А где машинка? Где моя машинка?
examples.trans: Hey, where's the toy car? Where's my toy car?

meanings.note: emphatic at the start of a sentence
+ dative of person + accusative of thing
imperative давай/давайте + 1st person plural or infinitive

examples.text: Давай мы его уволим, а тебя на его место назначим.
examples.trans: Let's fire him and put you in his place.

related.gloss: to hand in; to take (an exam)

meanings.note: Много дел = a lot to do.

examples.trans: I have a lot to do.

examples.text: Мне некогда об этом думать. Слишком много дел.
examples.trans: I have no time to think about that. There's too much to do.

meanings.note: condition: если хочешь = if you want; а если нет? = and if not?

meanings.en: (colloquial) to quit, to knock it off
meanings.note: завязывай с этим = cut it out

examples.text: Завязывал бы ты с картами, играть не умеешь.
examples.trans: You should quit cards, you can't play.

заниматься.gloss: to be busy with, to do

meanings.en: to do, to be engaged in
meanings.note: + instrumental: заниматься бизнесом = be in business

related.gloss: to take up, to attend to (pf)

meanings.note: To run for a second term.

examples.trans: He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

examples.text: На нашей кухне все умеют импровизировать.
examples.trans: In our kitchen everyone knows how to improvise.

meanings.note: Искусство войны = The Art of War.

examples.trans: Read The Art of War, by Sun Tzu!
She loves modern art very much.
This is a real culinary work of art!
The restaurant critic praised the bartender.

examples.text: К нам сегодня приедет ресторанный критик.
examples.trans: A restaurant critic will come to us today.
A restaurant critic is sitting in the hall.

мешать.gloss: to be in the way, to disturb

meanings.en: to be in the way, to hinder

meanings.note: cooking: мешать ложкой = to stir with a spoon

examples.trans: The radiators are in the way.

examples.text: Филиппыч, миксер проехать не может. Радиаторы мешают.
examples.trans: Filippych, the mixer truck can't get through. The radiators are in the way.

meanings.note: нас = us (gen/acc/prep); у нас = we have, at our place

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.text: Никто не будет командовать на моей кухне!
examples.trans: Nobody is going to give orders in my kitchen!

examples.text: Не говори об этом никому, ладно?
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone about this, okay?
But legally you are nobody to her.

meanings.note: hesitation, at the start of a sentence

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.

examples.text: Я выйду отсюда через две недели. Я решу все ваши проблемы.
examples.trans: I'll be out of here in two weeks. I'll solve all your problems.

examples.text: Не надо, Самсон. Сейчас придёт охрана.
examples.trans: Don't, Samson. Security will be here any second.
There was a staff reshuffle in the department.

meanings.note: поднимать шум = to make a fuss

examples.text: Поднимай меня вон туда, на третий этаж!
examples.trans: Lift me up there, to the third floor!

examples.text: Друзья, поднимаем бокалы, пьём за нашего шефа!
examples.trans: Friends, raise your glasses, let's drink to our chef!
Security will be here any moment.

examples.text: Не надо, Самсон. Сейчас придёт охрана.
examples.trans: Don't, Samson. Security will be here any second.

meanings.note: polite formula, at a door or before asking something

examples.trans: May we come in? Good day, sir.

meanings.note: informal: a group of young men; ребята! = guys!

examples.trans: The boys will have a word with you.

examples.text: Тогда ребята с тобой поработают. До свидания, Аркадий Борисович.
examples.trans: Then the boys will have a little word with you. Goodbye, Arkady Borisovich.

собраться.gloss: to get ready, plan to, gather

meanings.en: to intend, plan, get ready to

examples.text: Ты что, уходить от меня собрался?
examples.trans: Are you planning to leave me or what?
Are you planning to drink alcohol?

examples.text: Хорошо, тогда с тебя весёлый сценарий праздника.
examples.trans: Good, then you are responsible for a fun party script.
Go ahead and read your script.

meanings.en: to go on, be happening (usually of chaos or strange events)

examples.trans: So much is going on in the country!

examples.text: А, точно. Перепутал. Такое в стране творится! Продолжаем операцию.
examples.trans: Oh, right. I mixed them up. So much is going on in the country! Continue the operation.

examples.text: Такое в стране творится! Продолжаем операцию.
examples.trans: So much is going on in the country! Continue the operation.
There's someone here to see you.

examples.text: Аркадий Борисович, извините, тут к вам человек.
examples.trans: Arkady Borisovich, I'm sorry, there's a man here to see you.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

examples.trans: What a lovely morning! Lidia Alekseyevna, a cup of coffee, please.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!

meanings.note: alone: 'я этого не хочу' = I don't want that

examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat.

examples.text: Меня уже тошнит от этой коммуналки! У нас труба уже неделю течёт.
examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat! Our pipe has been leaking for a week now.
